subject: Quick: convert 9/23 onsite demo to remote — Emerald Health travel conflict
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@emeraldhealth.com>

Cc: Scott Liu <scott.liu@emeraldhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 16:07:00 -0700

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for scheduling the demo for Thursday (9/23). Quick heads up — our procurement lead and two of our execs are travelling for site visits that day and just informed me they won't be in the office for the afternoon session (we only have the morning window with a handful of stakeholders).

I don't want to lose the momentum on this, so two quick asks: can we either (A) convert the 9/23 onsite session to a remote walkthrough for the whole group in the morning, or (B) move to an alternative date next week when the full team is available?

I'm attaching our team's travel itinerary for transparency. If a remote call works, the AM 10:00–11:00 PT slot still looks good for my side.

Appreciate any flexibility — apologies for the late notice.

Best,
Elena

Attachments: itinerary.pdf (1.2 MB)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@emeraldhealth.com>

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sending the itinerary. Totally understandable.

We can absolutely convert Thursday's session to a remote walkthrough. A couple of items to make sure it's smooth: 
- Ben (SE) would like to run a short pre-call to confirm network access and the demo account.
- Marissa (AE) will keep the meeting notes and capture any follow-ups for the folks who were planning to attend onsite.

Option A (recommended): Keep 9/23 at 10:00–11:00 PT as a remote meeting. We'll send a new calendar invite with the remote link and a pared-down agenda so the session is productive for the smaller morning group. We'll record the session and share the recording and the demo-artifacts.

Option B: If you prefer the full onsite audience, propose 9/28 or 9/30 and we'll check availability on our side.

Proposed next steps: Elena confirms whether we should switch to remote (A) or reschedule (B). If A, Ben — can you take the lead on a 15-minute pre-call this week to validate access? Marissa — I’ll ask you to update the agenda and send the invite.

Thanks — Sofia

- Confirm VPN / SSO access to the test tenant or provide a temporary demo account
- Verify sample prompt sets for the session to ensure we surface the right workflows
- Confirm recording permissions and where to drop artifacts after the call

We'll plan to have the smaller decision-making group on the call and then watch the recording later with the rest of the execs. If anything changes on our side I'll flag immediately.

Scott will join the pre-call: scott.liu@emeraldhealth.com; please include a calendar invite for the connectivity check.

Elena
